text:
olivia_sales: Heads-up: TeraHealth POC wrap. Customer asked us to fully deprovision the trial environment and provide a signed attestation that request payloads were removed. Need owner for keys, pool, and VPC cleanup. ETA requested: end of week.

devin_se: I can take the hosted keys and the dedicated pool teardown. Need exact pool id and whether they want any metrics retained.

olivia_sales: Pool id is ded-tera-2026. They want anonymized metrics (qps, p50/p99) retained, but ALL request bodies and any identifiers deleted immediately. No backups containing payloads to be kept.

noah_sre: Proposed checklist to execute: 
1) Disable + rotate all Hosted API keys tied to tenant
2) Export aggregated metrics and place in audits/terahealth/
3) Purge request logs and any S3 objects with payloads
4) Purge Redis/KV cache prefixes for tenant
5) Drain and delete dedicated pool namespace + reclaim PVs
6) Confirm VPC peering entries removed and security group rules cleaned
7) Generate attestation and hand to legal for signature

anya_pm: Reminder: our POC baseline retention is 30 days payloads, 12 months for metrics. Customer explicitly asked for immediate payload purge; we should record a signed attestation when done.

devin_se: Drafting the exact commands I'll run; dropping them here for review.

```
# revoke hosted keys
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/keys/disable -d '{"key":"tera-poc-key-1"}'

# mark pool no-new and snapshot metrics
rw-admin pool update --id ded-tera-2026 --no-new-alloc
rw-metrics export --pool ded-tera-2026 --format json --out /tmp/tera_metrics_$(date +%F).json

# cache purge
rw-cache purge --tenant terahealth --match "tenant:terahealth:*" --force

# namespace deletion
kubectl delete ns tera-terahealth-poc --wait
```

noah_sre: Couple of infra notes: check for leftover snapshots in backup-svc and manually unmount PVs if kubectl hangs. Also ensure any model KV-cache keyed with tenant id is cleared.

infra-bot: Teardown job scheduled: teardown-tera-1775254321 by devops. Pending approval. ETA 2026-06-15T09:00:00Z.

devin_se: Two sales/finance/legal questions before I proceed:
- Should we cancel the Dedicated reservation billing or leave it active until contract renewal?
- Do they want a signed attestation PDF or a simple confirmation email?

finance: We cannot cancel mid-cycle. Mark resource unused and open FIN ticket to track.

legal_team: Customer asked for a signed attestation. We will prepare a one-page attestation once ops confirms purge.

anya_pm: I'll own attestation flow. I need: metrics export path, confirmation log entries, and S3 purge manifest.

devin_se: Approving infra-bot job now and starting actions. Will post timestamps.

infra-bot: Job teardown-tera-1775254321 approved by devin_se. Stage 1 (disable keys) started.

devin_se: Disabled keys: tera-poc-key-1, tera-poc-key-2. Rotation scheduled.

devin_se: Metrics export completed: s3://audits/terahealth/metrics-20260615.json. Uploaded with checksum.

noah_sre: Cache purge done. Confirmed no keys remaining with prefix tenant:terahealth.

infra-bot: Namespace tera-terahealth-poc deletion complete. PVs reclaimed: 3. Snapshots checked: none retained.

devin_se: Dedicated pool ded-tera-2026 deleted via rw-admin. Billing status: flagged inactive; opened FIN-9010 to track billing hold.

noah_sre: Request logs purge completed at 2026-06-15T09:40:12Z. Verified S3 manifests: all objects with prefix requests/terahealth/ removed.

anya_pm: Attestation draft created and sent to legal. Will upload signed PDF to s3://audits/terahealth/attestations/ once signed.

legal_team: Attestation signed and uploaded: s3://audits/terahealth/attestations/tera_attestation_20260615.pdf

devin_se: Audit entries written: /ops/audit/POC-5987.json. Closing infra job.

olivia_sales: Customer updated: "All POC artifacts removed, keys revoked, pool and infra torn down. Attestation received." Customer replied with :white_check_mark: and asked for invoice hold confirmation.

finance: FIN-9010 updated to indicate reservation will be held until renewal.

noah_sre: Final security checklist (all items confirmed):
- Keys disabled and rotated
- Metrics exported and stored
- Request payloads purged from logs/S3
- Cache and KV entries removed
- Namespace and PVs deleted
- VPC/peering and SG rules reverted
- Attestation signed and stored

devin_se: Final note: POC ticket POC-5987 -> status: closed. Leaving a short runbook snippet in ops-runbooks/poc-exits.md for future reference.

olivia_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll send the final closure email to the customer and archive the thread. :thumbsup:
